settings.textPreviewLimitHint: Files above this whole-file limit show attributes instead of partial text.
settings.visualDistanceLimitHint: How different two photos may look and still pair. Lower is stricter; flat graphics crowd together, so a corpus of icons wants a lower number than photos do.
settings.burstVisualDistanceHint: The relaxed limit for photos taken within the burst gap of each other. Real bursts differ more than the strict limit tolerates — a hand shifts, a child turns — and close capture times vouch for them.
settings.familyWidthHint: How far one family may spread. 1 means every photo must resemble the family’s first member directly; 2 lets a burst whose ends differ meet through its middle. Higher risks unrelated subjects chaining into one family.
settings.scoreFaces: Score faces for photo ordering (background, needs the face models)

work.title: Background work
work.intro: Pausing keeps completed work and never changes your files. These controls apply to this app session; Settings decides which optional features are enabled. Pause all pauses file information, preparation, and enrichment. Source checking has its own Stop control; folder watching stays active.
work.sourceCheckDescription: One pass to find added, removed, or changed files. Folder watching continues afterward.

work.snapshotsDescription: Timestamped scene frames for quickly understanding a video.
work.similarityDescription: Rebuilds similar-photo families after preview facts change.
work.facesDescription: Optional face and expression scoring used to order comparison groups.
work.videoTranscriptsDescription: Optional speech-to-text for videos with audio.
trash.title: Deleted files
trash.intro: Each configured root keeps its deleted files beneath its own permission boundary. OneCopy never empties these folders automatically. Emptying is permanent; removing their contents in the file manager is also safe.
trash.totalsNotRefreshed: Deleted files were processed, but their totals couldn’t be refreshed.
